en: Black‑and‑white postcard view of a broad, unpaved street in a European town. Two- and three‑story houses with steep tiled roofs line both sides. Several adults and many children stand or walk in the street; a man rides a bicycle at right. On the right-hand side is a building with a painted wall sign for a restaurant. In the far distance, centered in the street axis, is a church tower with a dome or baroque-style cupola and cross.
